steps.title: What this tour covers
steps.body: Greetings start in `navigation/greet.go` and print from `code/main.go`. Six steps; about two minutes.

steps.title: Greet delegates to Format
steps.body: `Greet` adds no text of its own: it passes a fixed salutation and the name to `Format`, so every greeting shares one shape.
